Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Sajjad Ahmad, Advocate for the 
applicant.
Mr. J.S. Virk, D.A.G. with Mr. Deepak 
Bhardwaj, Brief Holder for the State.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits 
that there are 20 charge-sheeted witnesses, but 
till date only 13 witnesses have been 
completely examined. The examination of the 
14th witness is still underway. The appellant is 
in custody for a long and it is a case fit for bail.
Learned State counsel would submit that 
total 14 witnesses are to be examined. The 14th
witness was examined in the month of May, 
2026, but somehow, he has been transferred to 
some other district, therefore, his presence
could not be secured on the next date. Now, 
29.05.2026, is the date fixed for examination of 
PW 14.
List on 18.06.2026. On that date, learned 
State counsel shall give a statement as to what 
is the progress of the trial.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.) 
 21.05.2026
Jitendra
